Name: Elle's Farmhouse Pride
Author: junimods
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n4XdwZb.png[/img]﻿

﻿- 36 options for pride flags
﻿- 36 options for pride banners
- 33 options for pride buntings
- made for vanilla farmhouses
- compatible with custom house paints
- compatible with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6330]Seasonal Vanilla Buildings[/url] mod
- has a separate version for my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1993]Seasonal Buildings[/url] mod

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ad9prRZ.png[/img]﻿

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
3. Unzip/extract the[b] [color=#f6b26b][CP] Elle's Farmhouse Pride[/color][/b] folder into your [b]\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/b] folder.
4. Run the game once with SMAPI to generate a [b]config.json[/b].
5. Open the config.json with a program like Notepad and use the image in the References folder to set the flag or banner to the one you want. You can disable either feature with [font=Courier New][color=#e69138]false[/color][/font]. If you can't get a config.json to generate, you can rename the example_config.json to config.json and use it instead.
6. Run the game using SMAPI to play!

If using the Seasonal Buildings version, you will also need to change the [font=Courier New][color=#e69138]Color Palette[/color][/font], [font=Courier New][color=#e69138]Farmhouse Style[/color][/font], and the 3 [font=Courier New][color=#e69138]Cabin Style[/color][/font] options to be the same as your config in the Seasonal Buildings Mod.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hxvaHeU.png[/img]﻿

1.0.3 - Added pride banners to cabins
         - Added xenogender options
         - Added demigirl options
         - Added demiboy options
         - Changed option names in config to include word "farmhouse"
         - Fixed bigender2 bunting on upgraded farmhouses
         - Fixed some color issues on a few options
1.0.2 - Added new "Pride Bunting" option in the config: this adds a string of small flags with the colors of the pride flag you choose
         - Moved the banners on the first 2 tiers of the house to make room for new buntings
         - Added 2 bigender options
         - Added 2 autism pride options
         - Added sapphic and achillean options
         - Added neptunic and uranic options﻿
1.0.1 - Added new polyamory option ﻿(Polyamory2)
         - Made compatible with custom house paints
